clips.title: The story
paras: In the northern Barrens, Venture Company machinery lies battered after a failed inspection. The damaged samophlange must reach goblin experts in Orgrimmar, where someone may understand how it works.

The Venture Company made samophlanges for its resource work in the northern Barrens. Wenikee Boltbucket tried to inspect and modify one, adding gauges, levers, and dials to measure its stability. Her tinkering weakened the mechanism instead, leaving it battered and close to ruin. Knowing more additions might make it fail completely, she sent the fragile device to someone with factory experience.

Repairing the device calls for someone who has worked on Venture Company production lines. Rilli Greasygob, a former Venture employee, works at Nogg's Machine Shop in Orgrimmar's Valley of Honor. The battered apparatus catches the engineer's eye. Anyone who scavenges from goblin operations may seem daring, or simply foolhardy.
